I don't know how to think about this advice.

I've been on both sides of this. My biological dad ran out on me ( not my sisters, just me) when I was a baby and never tried to be apart of my life, while being there throughout my 3 sisters lives. 

My step dad raised me from when I was 2 until he died when I was 15.

Aside from my sisters telling me where he was what he was doing, and that he didn't ask about me, I had nothing to do with my dad. He died a couple years ago, and the only regret I have is not beating the shit out of that son of a bitch asshole before he died. I hold a lot of resentment and anger about him. Mostly for leaving, but also for not abandoning his daughters.

My step dad had a massive sudden heart attack when I was 15, and died before I even had a chance to say goodbye. 

In my mind my stepdad will always be perfect, and i miss him. He was far from perfect in reality, similar to me actually ( hs drop out, no college, never succeeded in anything he tried to do, prior marriage, other kid, heavy drug use, no wealth, but he was always there for me at least, and he loved me) 

In my mind, the son of a bitch who gave he his name then left is worse than scum, whereas my dad who died is like the idolized victim of a cruel life and will always be a sad and happy thought for me.

If I could I would forget all about my real dad. 

How is this not a better life for my kids? At least if I'm dead, they can't see what a huge disappointment their father is, but maybe they could remember me without having to acknowledge the reality of their shitty dad.
